stem: You are optimizing a database query joining two tables: Orders (10,000,000 rows) and Customers (50,000 rows). Which indexing strategy will yield the greatest latency reduction?

options.A: Add a B-Tree index on Orders.customer_id
options.B: Add a Full-Text index on Customers.name
options.C: Rebuild the primary key on Customers table
options.D: Disable foreign key constraints during reads

scoring_logic: Correct: A (Indexed foreign key lookups on the 10M-row table eliminate full table scans).

stem: An algorithm has a time complexity of O(N log N). If N doubles from 1,000 to 2,000, how does the number of operations scale approximately?

options.B: It slightly more than doubles (~2.2x)
options.C: It quadruples (4x)
options.D: It scales exponentially

scoring_logic: Correct: B (N log N increases by 2 * (log 2000 / log 1000) ~= 2.2x).

options.B: Squash deletes the remote branch automatically

options.D: Squash reverts uncommitted working directory changes

scoring_logic: Correct: A (Squash condenses all branch changes into one working tree change).

stem: A REST API returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests. What is the standard protocol-compliant client behavior?

options.A: Retry immediately with a different User-Agent header
options.B: Parse the Retry-After header and apply exponential backoff with jitter
options.C: Open multiple parallel TCP connections to bypass rate limits
options.D: Switch request method from POST to PUT

scoring_logic: Correct: B (Respecting Retry-After with exponential backoff prevents stampeding herd).
